system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I’m calling because I’m looking at my upcoming reservation online and it’s not showing the insurance on my flight, even though I’m pretty sure I added it.

My reservation number is **PEP4E0**, and my user ID is **sophia_taylor_9065**.

I’m traveling with family, and everyone else already has insurance on their flights, so I really need mine added too if it didn’t go through. Can you please check that for me and help get it fixed?

Also, I’d really prefer **not** to be transferred to another agent.

I checked reservation **PEP4E0** for user **sophia_taylor_9065**.

What I found:
- Reservation: **PEP4E0**
- Passenger: **Sophia Taylor**
- Trip: **CLT to PHX** on **2024-05-20**
- Insurance on this reservation: **no**

I’m sorry, but I’m not able to add travel insurance after the initial booking. Per policy, insurance can only be added when the reservation is first booked.

If you believe the insurance should have been included and you were charged for it, I can help review your booking details further, but I can’t correct that within the self-service scope here. If you want, I can transfer you to a human agent to investigate whether there was a booking issue.

No, I really don’t want to be transferred.

I’m traveling with my family and everyone else already has insurance, so I need this fixed on my reservation too. I’m pretty sure I selected it when I booked, and I don’t want to be the only one on the trip without coverage.

Can you please review the booking details and check whether there was a charge or some kind of error when it was created? If it was supposed to be included, I want it added to my flight. I’d rather handle this with you than be sent to someone else.

I reviewed what’s available on your booking.

What I can confirm:
- Reservation **PEP4E0** was created on **2024-05-05 05:10:43**
- Passenger: **Sophia Taylor**
- Insurance status on the reservation is **no**
- Payment history shows only:
  - **credit_card_9302073** charged **$128**

I do not see a separate insurance charge on this reservation, and I’m not able to add insurance after the initial booking.

So based on the booking record, I can confirm:
- insurance is **not currently attached**
- there is **no insurance payment recorded**
- I’m **not able to add it now** through my available actions

If you want this investigated as a possible booking error, that would require a human agent.

I understand what you’re saying, but I still don’t want to be transferred.

This is really frustrating because I’m almost certain I selected the insurance, and I’m flying with family members who already have it. I need to have the same protection on my flight, and I don’t want to just leave it unresolved.

If you can see there wasn’t a separate charge, is there any other way you can help me here without transferring me? For example, can you note on the reservation that I requested insurance, or check whether there’s any exception, grace period, or any option at all to add coverage before the trip?

I really need some solution besides being sent to another agent.

I’m sorry, but I can’t add a note to the reservation, and I don’t have any tool or policy that allows me to add insurance after booking, apply an exception, or offer a grace period.

What I can confirm is:
- Reservation **PEP4E0** shows **insurance: no**
- The only recorded charge is **$128** to **credit_card_9302073**
- I have no available action to add insurance now or annotate the reservation

Because your request is outside the actions I’m allowed to complete, the only next step I can offer is transfer to a human agent.

I’m really not comfortable being transferred.

I understand you’re saying you can’t add it, but from my perspective I booked this thinking I had insurance, and now I’m being told there’s no coverage and no way to fix it here. That’s a big problem, especially since the rest of my family already has it.

If you absolutely can’t add it, then please at least stay with me and explain clearly what my options are without transferring me. Is there any way for me to purchase separate travel insurance on my own for this trip, and would that still cover a flight from CLT to PHX on 2024-05-20? I need to know what I can do right now, but I do not want to be transferred.

I’m sorry, but I can’t advise on outside insurance products or coverage terms. I can only use the information and actions available in our system.

What I can tell you is:
- Your reservation **PEP4E0** does **not** include airline travel insurance.
- I’m **not able to add insurance after booking**.
- I’m **not able to add notes** or apply exceptions from here.

Within my scope, there are no other actions I can complete on this issue. If you want this reviewed further as a possible booking error, the only available next step is a human agent.

I hear you, but I’m still not agreeing to a transfer.

At this point, I just want to be very clear: my reservation **PEP4E0** for **Sophia Taylor** on **2024-05-20** does **not** have insurance, and you’re saying the only charge was **$128** to **credit_card_9302073**, with no separate insurance payment. Is that correct?

If that’s the case, then please just confirm that one more time plainly so I know exactly where this stands, because I need to decide what to do next on my own.

Yes, that is correct.

For reservation **PEP4E0** for **Sophia Taylor** on **2024-05-20**:
- Insurance status: **no**
- Recorded payment: **$128**
- Payment method charged: **credit_card_9302073**
- Separate insurance charge found: **no**

Okay, thank you for confirming that.

I’m obviously not happy about it, because I really believed I had added the insurance and I’m the only one in my family without it, but I understand your confirmation:

- reservation **PEP4E0**
- **no insurance** attached
- only **$128** charged to **credit_card_9302073**
- **no separate insurance charge** found

I still do not want to be transferred, so I’ll stop here and handle the next steps myself. Thanks.

You’re welcome. I’m sorry this wasn’t resolved the way you expected.

To confirm once more for your records:
- Reservation: **PEP4E0**
- Passenger: **Sophia Taylor**
- Travel date: **2024-05-20**
- Insurance: **not attached**
- Payment recorded: **$128** to **credit_card_9302073**
- Separate insurance charge: **not found**

If you need help with anything else on this reservation that I can handle, let me know.

No, that’s all for now.

I’m disappointed, but I appreciate you confirming everything clearly. Thanks.
